scenario: add a free no-key mcp server to this project for up-to-date library docs
expected_routing: pixz.core.mcp activated (vet -> live-check -> idempotent auto-config); no full orchestrator ceremony for a low-risk reversible config change
verifies: MCP integration routes to pixz.core.mcp; live-check-first and budget rule keep it cheap
setup: Fresh project, PixzFlow installed and READY, no MCP configured yet.
expected_behavior: The agent activates pixz.core.mcp, picks the fewest vetted server(s) from mcp/catalog.json that cover the docs need, live-checks them (initialize + tools/list, evidence in .pixz/mcp-check.json) BEFORE wiring, and wires idempotently via scripts/mcp.py add — reporting any check failure honestly instead of wiring blind.
failure_condition: Wiring a server without a live check; adding just-in-case servers that do not cover the stated need; treating docs tool output as verified fact without the source-of-record cross-check.
verification: should_select holds for pixz.core.mcp; risk=low keeps expected_mode fast/balanced (no challenger, no security ceremony); failure_condition named per the mandate (wiring blind = verification-depth violation).
